verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for small-business accounting SaaS, but nothing in the evidence documents a conversational or natural-language command interface in Wave. The automation features shown (bank-feed categorization, scheduled reminders, receipt OCR) are rule-based or extraction features, not natural-language control. The marketing pages document no AI, MCP, or CLI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
